mcq_data.question: Which of the following is a volatile memory in a computer system?
mcq_data.solution: RAM is volatile memory because it loses data when power is turned off.

mcq_data.question: Which component of the CPU performs arithmetic and logical operations?
mcq_data.solution: The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) performs all arithmetic and logical operations inside the CPU.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is an input device?
mcq_data.solution: OCR (Optical Character Reader) is an input device that reads printed text and converts it into digital form.

mcq_data.question: Laser printers are classified as:
mcq_data.solution: Laser printers are non-impact printers that use laser technology for high-quality printing.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following memory types is the fastest?
mcq_data.solution: Cache memory is the fastest memory, located close to the CPU to speed up processing.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the operating system?
mcq_data.solution: The operating system manages resources like processes, memory, and files, but it does not design hardware.

mcq_data.question: Which language processor translates and executes a program line by line?
mcq_data.solution: An interpreter translates and executes code line by line, making debugging easier but slower.

mcq_data.question: Which utility software is used to rearrange fragmented files on a disk?
mcq_data.solution: Disk Defragmenter rearranges fragmented files so they are stored contiguously, improving access speed.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is an example of open source software?
mcq_data.solution: Linux is an open source operating system freely available for use and modification.

mcq_data.question: Which input method allows typing Indian language text using English phonetics?
mcq_data.solution: Phonetic typing allows entering Indian language text by typing the equivalent English sounds.

mcq_data.question: Which device is used in banks to read characters printed with magnetic ink?
mcq_data.solution: MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Reader) is used in banks for reading cheque details.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is an example of a non-impact printer?
mcq_data.solution: Laser printers are non-impact printers that use laser beams for printing.

mcq_data.question: Registers in CPU are used for:
mcq_data.solution: Registers provide temporary high-speed storage for instructions and data during processing.

mcq_data.question: Which type of RAM needs to be refreshed continuously?
mcq_data.solution: DRAM (Dynamic RAM) needs continuous refreshing to retain data.

mcq_data.question: Which type of ROM can be erased using ultraviolet light?
mcq_data.solution: EPROM (Erasable Programmable Read Only Memory) can be erased with ultraviolet light.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is an example of general purpose application software?
mcq_data.solution: MS Excel is a general purpose spreadsheet software used in many fields.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of utility software?
mcq_data.solution: A compiler is a language processor, not a utility software.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following standards is used for representing Indian languages digitally?
mcq_data.solution: Unicode is a universal standard used to represent characters from multiple languages, including Indian languages.

mcq_data.question: Which port is used to transfer data one bit at a time?
mcq_data.solution: Serial ports transfer data one bit at a time, commonly used for modems and older mice.

mcq_data.question: Which of the following is an example of specific purpose application software?
mcq_data.solution: Payroll System is a specific purpose application software designed for salary management.
